attributes.name: collapsible disclosure widget
attributes.definition: Whether the page includes a native collapsible disclosure (details/summary) element for revealing content.

values.definition: Page includes a collapsible details/summary disclosure.
No collapsible disclosure element is used.

attributes.name: document title style
attributes.definition: How the page's document title (the title tag) is phrased.

values.definition: Title is just the organization or brand name.
Title includes SEO keywords or descriptive phrases, possibly with the brand.
Title combines brand with a page name or tagline using a separator.
Title follows another pattern or is missing.
